name: session-capture
description: Durable session memory. A UserPromptSubmit hook logs every user message to disk outside the context window (so it survives compaction), and Stop/PreCompact/SessionEnd hooks push that log to the PRIVATE skills repo via git plumbing (so it survives the ephemeral container). A SessionStart hook injects the evidence-ledger pointer so retrieval does not depend on remembering a trigger phrase. Fails closed: never pushes to a public repo, never blocks a prompt.
